messages:
alex: Kicking off infra apply for release/2026-03-canary in the 16:00 change window. Deploy bot posted the plan: https://redwood.internal/plans/2123456789

deploy-bot: plan available — `terraform plan -var-file=canary.tfvars` -> includes IAM role update for monitoring role. Plan summary: 8 adds, 2 changes, 1 delete.

miguel: I'm on preflight drift check now, will post findings in ~2m.

maggie: Quick note — providers pinned in providers.tf: `hashicorp/aws = "~> 5.10"`. Please do not bump providers or re-run `terraform init -upgrade` during the window.

divya: There's an IAM change to sts:AssumeRole on monitoring role; it's additive but I'll review least-privilege and sign off.

sam: Rollback procedure reminder: we control traffic via variable `canary_weight`. Canary apply uses `-var='canary_weight=10'`. To rollback quickly run: `terraform apply -var='canary_weight=0' -target=module.routing.canary` from the apply host.

miguel: Drift check result: found 1 route table CIDR drift in staging-only module, not referenced by prod. Proceeding to apply prod modules only. I'll run `terraform apply -target=module.vpc,module.iam -auto-approve` in 2 mins from bastion.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/release/runbooks/iam-canary-shift. Steps 1-6 include immediate rollback commands and notification templates.

alex: Monitoring plan: watch per-route p50/p95 latency + error-rate dashboard. Abort & rollback if error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 300ms.

oncall-bot: Alert policy configured: canary-errors (>1% over 5m) -> notify @sam, @maggie; escalate to pager if >10%.

maggie: I'll stand by and approve rollback manually if anything anomalous shows up.

miguel: Starting apply now (running from bastion, copying stdout):
```
applying... module.iam.aws_iam_role.monitoring: Modifying...
module.routing.null_resource.canary_weight: Creating...
apply complete in 42s
```

miguel: Post-apply: monitoring role updated, routing policy adjusted to 10% via Terraform. No apply errors reported.

alex: Gradual traffic shift started. Tagging release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-canary. Will wait 30m stable window before promoting.

divya: Confirmed IAM change matches least-privilege matrix and audit checks. No remediation required.

sam: I'll keep the 30m watch. If metrics are stable, plan to promote to 100% in the next change window and open a follow-up ticket for verification.

alex: Thanks all. If we need to rollback, follow the ops runbook, post a short incident note in #incidents and a postmortem in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
